newsitem.title: CHINA: Bucket chase kills three in China.
newsitem.headline: Bucket chase kills three in China.

text.p: An elderly man, his son and his grandson drowned trying to recover a fallen bucket from a Chinese well, a local newspaper reported.

Retired worker Sun Tieshan lost the bucket while drawing water from the nine-metre- (30-foot-) deep well in China's northwestern Xinjiang region, the Nanfang Daily said in an edition seen in Beijing on Sunday.
A neighbour, Liu Jichun, went down by rope to retrieve it, but the rope broke. Sun's son went down, rescued Liu, but found himself trapped.
Old Sun then fell in trying to help his son. And a grandson, trying to rescue both, also fell in.
By the time the fire department arrived, all three were dead, the newspaper said.
